context: Daichi and Mei chat about moving into a new home.
purpose: Casual register; vocabulary (借り/置か/住む/流し/我が) in natural home.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 新しい部屋を、借りることにしたの。
lines.en: I decided to rent a new room.
lines.style: soft warm woman voice, gentle excited delivery throughout

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: ええなあ、どの辺に住むんや?
lines.style: lively Kansai man voice, warm hearty delivery throughout

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 駅の近くに、住む予定なの。
lines.en: I plan to live near the station.
lines.style: gentle woman voice, soft warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: 台所の流しは、広いんか?
lines.style: cheerful Kansai man voice, warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 流しが大きくて、料理しやすいの。
lines.en: The sink is big and easy to cook at.
lines.style: soft woman voice, gentle warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: 荷物は、どこに置くんや?
lines.en: Where will you put your stuff?
lines.style: lively Kansai man voice, warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 本は、棚に置こうと思ってるの。
lines.en: I'm thinking of putting books on a shelf.
lines.style: gentle woman voice, soft warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: 我が家にも、遊びに来てや!
lines.style: warm Kansai man voice, warm hearty closing delivery throughout
